Hi Liam / Ayesha —

Congrats again on the signature — excited to get Stellar Neuro into a production-ready cadence. I attached a working execution checklist (lightweight MAP-style format) and a one-page evaluation slate we recommend running during the canary window. High-level proposal below: 

- Week 0 (this week): Contract acceptance + DocuSign, kickoff call, shared Drive + access for devs
- Week 1: Staged canary (10% traffic) — focused evals: latency, hallucination spot-checks, embeddings stability
- Week 2-3: Narrow expansion (30-60%) + user training sessions (train-the-trainer + ops runbook)
- Week 4: Full cutover readiness review and agreed rollback criteria

Open items for this thread: 
1) Confirm DocuSign target completion date (we can auto-send if you prefer)
2) Agree on canary acceptance criteria (I put suggested metrics in Eval_Slate_v1.pdf)
3) Scheduling training windows (preferred evenings PST vs daytime EST)

Attachments: MAP_Stellar_Execution_Checklist.xlsx; Eval_Slate_v1.pdf

If this looks good I’ll update the checklist with owners and push to the shared Drive link below.

Thanks —
Olga

- Training: we prefer late-afternoon sessions (3–5pm PT) for the clinical team — avoids patient hours.

Thanks, Olga — quick replies inline and a small update attached.

- Hallucination threshold: we recommend <= 2% failure rate on clinically scoped prompts across a 200-sample spot-check. See page 2 of Eval_Slate_v1.pdf for sampling plan.
- Canary duration: for clinical workflows we suggest a 5-day ramp at 10% with daily monitoring (automated alerts + on-call CS engineer). If you prefer tighter windows we can do 48–72 hours but will add a safety buffer in the autoscaler settings.
- Training windows: confirmed — we will schedule 3 sessions, 3–5pm PT next Tue/Wed/Thu; will record for the extended team.

Attachments included as well: MAP_Stellar_Execution_Checklist.xlsx (I added owners for the first two sprints), Eval_Slate_v1.pdf

Next steps I’ll take:
- Upload checklist to shared Drive and set owners (Olga: will you confirm owners for 'clinical review' and 'rollback exec'?)
- Provision a canary cluster on our Dedicated pool, target start Mon 9/6
- Send a brief runbook to Procurement with the DocuSign link so they can finish admin steps

Thanks everyone — consolidated update below and next steps (owners assigned).

Decisions taken:
- DocuSign: Ben has uploaded final SOW and run-rate to the packet. Procurement link: DocuSign: https://docusign.example/rDW-578 (see attachments list). Target signature date: 2026-09-04 EOD.
- Canary: Start Mon 2026-09-06, 10% traffic for 5 days. Acceptance = <=2% hallucination on clinical sample + <150ms p50 token latency for API calls under the canary traffic profile.
- Training: 3 sessions scheduled Tue/Thu/Fri next week, 3–5pm PT — Grace to run training and record sessions.
- Rollback: Added one-paragraph rollback clause to the SOW in the Drive (folder link below) — covered steps to revert model version, invalidate KV cache, and a post-rollback integrity check plan.
- Telemetry & retention: Redwood will retain anonymized telemetry buckets for 90 days; Stellar retains raw logs in their S3. Details in the 'Telemetry & Audit' tab of the checklist.
